title: Inception
description: A skilled thief enters human subconscious dreams to steal corporate secrets and is given a mission to plant an idea into a mind through psychological simulation.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer hacker discovers that human reality is an artificial subconscious simulation created by machines and joins a rebellion to free the human mind.

title: Interstellar
description: A team of astronauts travels through a wormhole in deep outer space on an epic mission to find a new habitable planet and ensure humanity survival.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces the Joker a psychopathic criminal mastermind who creates anarchy and terror in Gotham City.

title: Batman Begins
description: Bruce Wayne trains with martial artists in shadows to fight corruption and organized crime in Gotham City as Batman.

title: The Avengers
description: Earth mightiest superheroes including Iron Man and Captain America team up to battle alien invaders and protect the world from destruction.

title: Iron Man
description: A billionaire genius inventor and superhero builds a high-tech powered armor suit to fight terrorists and high-tech corporate enemies.

title: Titanic
description: A young poor artist and an aristocratic woman fall deeply in love aboard the luxurious doomed passenger ship Titanic across social differences.

title: The Notebook
description: A passionate young man and a wealthy young woman fall deeply in love but are separated by social differences and time across decades.

title: La La Land
description: An aspiring actress and a jazz pianist fall deeply in love while pursuing their artistic passions and careers in Los Angeles.

title: The Lion King
description: A young lion prince flees his kingdom after his father is killed and embarks on a journey with friends to reclaim his royal home.

title: Finding Nemo
description: A timid clownfish father embarks on an epic ocean journey with a forgetful friend to rescue his captured young son.

title: Toy Story
description: A cowboy doll feels jealous and threatened when a fancy new spaceman action figure becomes a young boy favorite toy leading to an adventure.

title: The Godfather
description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine mafia family empire to his reluctant youngest son.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: The interconnected lives of two mob hitmen a boxer a gangster and a crime boss unfold in quirky violent stories in Los Angeles.

title: The Lord of the Rings
description: A courageous young Hobbit and companions embark on an epic quest across Middle-earth to destroy a powerful dark ring and defeat the Dark Lord.
